canonical_example.text: El control antidoping de los jugadores dio negativo.
canonical_example.translation: The drug test given to the players came back negative.

canonical_example.translation: The police set up roadblocks on the highway exits to look for the fugitives.

canonical_example.text: Hace tres meses que el emperador no sale del palacio imperial.
canonical_example.translation: The emperor hasn't left the imperial palace in three months.

canonical_example.text: Conservo un álbum de fotos de mi tiempo en México.
canonical_example.translation: I keep an album of photographs of my time in Mexico.

canonical_example.translation: The Rolling Stones have released a new album. Have you heard it?

canonical_example.text: El ensayo es para entregar la última semana de clases.
canonical_example.translation: The essay is to be turned in the last week of school.

canonical_example.text: Hoy me han entregado las llaves de la casa.
canonical_example.translation: I was given the keys to the house today.

canonical_example.text: El mensajero entregó el paquete a tiempo.
canonical_example.translation: The courier delivered the package on time.

canonical_example.translation: The troops surrendered at nightfall.

canonical_example.translation: The thief turned himself in to the police.

canonical_example.translation: He devoted himself to prayer all his life.

canonical_example.text: En un momento de pura desesperación hasta pensaba saltar de la ventana para escaparme.
canonical_example.translation: In a moment of pure desperation I even thought of jumping out of the window to escape.

canonical_example.text: En lugar de abandonarse a la desesperación, decidió buscar ayuda.
canonical_example.translation: Instead of giving in to despair, he decided to seek help.

canonical_example.text: Me viene la desesperación al ver lo tranquila que es.
canonical_example.translation: It drives me mad to see how calm she is.

canonical_example.text: Estas cosas llevan su tiempo. ¡Y es una desesperación esperar!
canonical_example.translation: These things take time - and it is maddening to wait!

canonical_example.translation: The castle seems vulnerable to enemy attacks.
